slot.subtopic: Range of a sin + b cos
slot.brief: Find the range/maximum of an expression of the form a sin θ + b cos θ + c using the auxiliary-angle amplitude bound.

stem: The range, for real $\theta$, of $5\sin\theta+12\cos\theta-2$ is

verdicts.working: The amplitude is $\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13$, so the range is $[-13-2,\,13-2]=[-15,11]$.

working:
$5\sin\theta+12\cos\theta\in[-\sqrt{5^2+12^2},\sqrt{5^2+12^2}]=[-13,13]$. Hence the range is $[-15,11]$.

Independent check: The amplitude is $\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13$, so the range is $[-13-2,\,13-2]=[-15,11]$.
solution:
For $a\sin\theta+b\cos\theta$, the amplitude is $\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$. Thus
$$5\sin\theta+12\cos\theta\in[-\sqrt{5^2+12^2},\sqrt{5^2+12^2}]=[-13,13].$$
Subtracting $2$, the range is $[-15,11]$.
